claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament begins its first round on Thursday, April 9.
The honorary starters for the 2026 Masters Tournament first round are Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson.
The honorary starters tee off at 7:25 a.m. ET for the 2026 Masters Tournament first round.
The first tee times for the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament second round is on Friday, April 10.
The first tee times for the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 tee times begin around 10:30 a.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Round 4 tee times start around 10:30 a.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Thursday and Friday is 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament on Saturday and Sunday is 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Featured groups streaming for the 2026 Masters Tournament begins earlier via Masters.com and Paramount+.
